sbar.situation: The bank is recovered. The last two recovery checks, ending at 31 s, ran the main journey cleanly with healthy metrics on every component.
sbar.background: An operator changed the payments setting max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1 about 12 s before detection, so payments rejected nearly everything with 422 errors. At the same time a malformed clearing item 91 crashed the clearing worker, a reconciliation session held a ledger write lock for 10.3 s, and the screening primary process exited with code 15.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander took every action itself. It reverted payments max_transfer_minor to 1000000, quarantined clearing item 91 and restarted clearing, and ended the reconciliation session holding the ledger lock. It also confirmed screening failover to the standby and restarted the screening primary, and every action succeeded.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team should, soon, review clearing item 91 and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. Payments rejected during the bad limit and postings delayed by the ledger lock may need review, so check why the operator set the limit to 1. Also check whether the reconciliation batch needs rerunning after its session was ended.
